name: Notice:
description:
Important Notice Regarding Settings Layout Changes.
对于设置界面排版更改的重要告知。

name: English Ver.
description: NovaFlare Engine 1.2.2 increased settings text size, causing overflow. I adjusted the layout to fit the new engine. To restore the old layout, delete "settings.json" in "data", then rename "settings.json.old1-2-1" to "settings.json".

name: 中文版本
description:
由于 NovaFlare Engine 1.2.2 增大了设置界面的文字，部分设置项可能会超出
屏幕。因此我调整了文字排版以适应新版引擎，部分排版可能看起来不太整齐。
如果你使用旧版引擎或不喜欢新的排版，请删除模组 "data" 文件夹中的 "settings.json"，然后将 "settings.json.old1-2-1" 重命名为 "settings.json"。

name: Debug ToolBox Settings
description: Set your debug toolbox settings...

name: Enable Debug ToolBox
description: If enabled, debugging shortcut keys can be used.

name: Soft Pause
description: Enable Soft Pause. Hold SPACE and press H or G to Soft Pause the game without pausing scripts, then press SPACE to resume the game.

name:
Independent
Scroll Speed
description: When enabled, changing the playback rate will not affect the note scroll speed.

name: Hide Tools Debug Print
description: If enabled, debug shortcut key prints will be hidden.

name:
Hide Tools Error/
Warn Prints
description: If enabled, debug shortcut key error and warning prints will be hidden.

name: Change Botplay Text
description: If disabled, using this tool to toggle the Botplay switch will not change the "botplayTxt.visible" state.

name: Showcase Mode
description: Enable recording showcase mode. Hide HUD, judgement information, strums and hide judgement notes.

name: Strum Alpha :
description: Set the transparency of strum arrows during Showcase Mode. 0% disables this feature.

name:
Health Bar
      Alpha :
description:
Set the transparency of the health bar and icons during Showcase Mode.
0% disables this feature.

name: Taunt Settings
description: Can taunt opponent...

name:
Taunt
    Key  :
description: Select the key used to taunt.

name:
Taunt
    Character  :
description: Select which character plays the "Hey" animation.

name:
Taunt
    Duration  :
description: Set how long the "Hey" animation lasts.

name:
"Hey" Sound
    Volume  :
description: Set the volume of the "Hey" sound effect when taunting.

name: VSlice Style Settings
description: Configure health bar smoothing and V-Slice style settings.

name: Health Bar Smoothing
description: Smoothly interpolates health changes instead of applying them instantly.

name:
Health Smooth
    Speed:
description: Controls how quickly the displayed health follows the target health.

name:
Sustain Health
    Amount:
description: Health gained or lost for each sustain note tick.

name: Opponent Health Drain
description: Makes opponent notes reduce player health.

name:
Opponent
     Drain Amount :
description: Health reduced by a normal opponent note when Opponent Health Drain is enabled.

name:
Opponent
     Drain Sustain :
description: Health reduced by an opponent sustain note when Opponent Health Drain is enabled.

name: V-Slice Score Text
description: Changes the score text style to match V-Slice.

name:
Enable Sustain
   Note Reward
description: If enabled, sustain notes can restore health and give score.

name: Hold Cover
description: Enable the V-Slice-style hold cover effect.

name:
Hold Cover
    Offset X :
description: Additional X offset applied to all Hold Covers.

name:
Hold Cover
    Offset Y :
description: Additional Y offset applied to all Hold Covers.

name: Ghost Tap Settings
description: Configure Ghost Tap punishment settings.

name: Ghost Tap Punishment
description: Enable Ghost Tap punishment. If disabled, Ghost Taps will not be counted or punished.

name:
Ghost Tap
    Limit :
description: Maximum number of Ghost Taps allowed within one second before punishment begins.

name:
Ghost Tap
    Warning Color :
description: Enable the Ghost Tap warning color effect on the player strums.

name:
Show Ghost Tap
    Count :
description: Show the current Ghost Tap count on the HUD.

name: -Other Settings-
description: Others...

name: Disable Botplay
description: If enabled, Botplay will be COMPLETELY disabled.

name: Miss Limit Count  :
description: If the number of misses exceeds this value, you will immediately fail (in all songs). Set it to -1 to disable.

name:
Score Text .
              Color ˙
description:
Set the score text color. Disable to allow other mods to modify it.
(Have 28 Colors!)

name: Blind Play :
description:
If enabled, will hide all notes during gameplay.
Only Player: Just hiding the player's notes, it allows you to guess the player's notes through the opponent's notes.
All: Hiding all the notes (would be way too hard, good luck)

name: One Note(Beta)
description: Merge the four player note lanes into one lane. Any direction key can hit notes, simultaneous notes are merged into one, and Sustain Notes are automatically completed.

name: !Advanced Settings!
description:
If you don't know what the settings below are for, 
DON'T touch them!!!

name:
OneNote Arrow .
                    Position ˙
description: Set OneNote arrow position. 0 = Left, 0.5 = Center, 1 = Right.

name: Rainbow Speed  :
description:
Adjust the color transition speed multiplier.
(only takes effect when the score text color is set to "Rainbow").

name:
Custom ScoreText 
    Color(RGB)
description:
Set the RGB value of a custom score color.
(only takes effect when the score text color is set to "Custom").

name: R  :
description: Set the R value of a custom score RGB color.

name: G  :
description: Set the G value of a custom score RGB color.

name: B  :
description: Set the B value of a custom score RGB color.

name: Advanced Debug Mode
description: Enable Advanced Debug Mode

name:
Disable Engine
    Version Check
description:
If enabled, the script will no longer check whether the runtime environment is NovaFlare Engine. Under normal circumstances, 
*DO NOT* enable this option.
